verdict.rationale: USCIS documents its own way to get your records: the Torch FOIA/Privacy Act API lets you create a request for your Alien File and track it by request number. That is a records request, not a self-serve export, and nothing shows the output is complete or in open, machine-readable formats. missing for 10: self-serve bulk export of online-account data, documented open/machine-readable export formats, evidence that the export covers all user data, a defined account-closure or exit path, independent or hands-on corroboration.
